description: The pinned Grype release binary (req-grype-binary). The version is the only place it appears; every archive sha256 is the release's own published digest, re-checked against the downloaded archive by tap_plugin.grype.pin_tool, which also computes binary_sha256, the digest of the grype executable inside. Renovate bumps `version`; run the pin tool to refresh the digests.
